description: Viral disease transmitted by biting insects, characterized by fever and firm nodules on the skin. Affects cattle and buffalo, with economic impact from reduced milk production, weight loss, and secondary infections of skin lesions.
symptoms: firm skin nodules on neck and body
critical_symptoms: firm skin nodules on neck and body
first_aid: Isolate the animal to reduce insect exposure and limit spread within the herd.
Apply fly control measures on the farm (clean manure, insecticide as advised locally).
Keep the animal in shade with fresh water and good-quality forage.
Do not burst or cut skin nodules; keep lesions clean and dry.
Contact a veterinarian for supportive care and official reporting if required in your district.
